description:
`tests/fixture_matrix.rs` subtracts the FIXTURE's leading-comment-line count from
every gutter number in the diagnostics text, regardless of which file the snippet
belongs to.

`normalize_path_line_ref` (:378) is gated correctly -- it rewrites a line number
only when the line contains `self.canonical_source_name()`:

    let marker = format!("{}:", self.canonical_source_name());
    let Some(start) = line.find(&marker) else { return line.to_string(); };

`normalize_gutter_line_ref` (:400) has NO such gate: it takes any leading
`<digits> |` and pushes it through `normalize_reported_line_number` (:440),
which is `reported - self.leading_comment_lines()` (:445, counting `#` lines in
the fixture).

## Observed at HEAD, no edit required -- the goldens are already self-inconsistent

    $ ./target/debug/fz2 interp fixtures2/behavior/enum_sort.fz 2>&1 >/dev/null | head -4
    warning[type/no-matching-clause]: `fn` clauses don't cover every input
      --> runtime:Enum.fz:437:3
        |
    437 |   fnp split_sort_list([left_head, right_head | tail], left, right) do

    $ head -4 fixtures2/behavior/enum_sort.expected.diagnostics
    warning[type/no-matching-clause]: `fn` clauses don't cover every input
      --> runtime:Enum.fz:437:3
        |
    376 |   fnp split_sort_list([left_head, right_head | tail], left, right) do

Header 437, gutter 376, difference 61 = enum_sort.fz's comment-header length.
Line 376 of src/modules/runtime_library/enum.fz is BLANK; line 437 is the clause
the snippet shows. The second warning has header 449 / gutter 388, and line 388
is `@spec take_positive_finish({[a], integer}) :: [a]`.

## Consequence

Editing prose in a fixture's own comment header changes the offset applied to
snippets in OTHER files, so a documentation edit -- which CLAUDE.md requires
alongside code changes -- mechanically re-reds the fixture on all three paths and
forces a golden re-bless whose diff carries zero information about the program.
The printed line numbers also do not exist in the file being cited.

Not nondeterminism: repeated direct `fz2 interp` runs print the true gutter (437)
every time. The shift is introduced by the harness alone.

## Fix

Gate `normalize_gutter_line_ref` the way `normalize_path_line_ref` is gated --
renumber a gutter line only while inside a snippet whose `-->` header names the
fixture's own `canonical_source_name()`. The gutter line carries no path of its
own, so the normalizer must track the current snippet's file as it walks
(it maps line-by-line via `normalize_reported_source_lines` at :369 and has no
such state today).

## Affected goldens

7 of the 15 `expected.diagnostics` files under fixtures2/behavior cite `runtime:`
sources and need re-blessing: enum_list_allocations, enum_map_family,
enum_oracle_smoke, enum_sort, membership_operator, map_enumerable,
range_enumerable.

The old ticket said 14 files and did not name the affected set.

## Checks

- After the fix, `enum_sort.expected.diagnostics` gutter reads 437/449, matching
  its own headers and the true lines in enum.fz.
- Adding a comment line to `fixtures2/behavior/enum_sort.fz` leaves
  `enum_sort.expected.diagnostics` byte-identical.
- Fixture-owned diagnostics (a warning raised against the fixture itself) still
  renumber, so those goldens are unchanged.
- Full matrix green.
title: fixture_matrix's gutter-line normalizer is ungated, so a fixture's comment header silently renumbers snippets from other files
